title: Oven Roasted Italian Pork Risotto
description: A hearty and comforting Italian dish featuring roasted pork and a creamy risotto, made with palm sugar and a touch of mustard, perfect for a cozy evening meal. This low-glycemic-friendly recipe is a great option for those looking for a healthier take on a classic dish.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Season the pork shoulder with salt, pepper, and mustard, and roast in the oven for 20 minutes.
In a large saucepan, heat the olive oil over medium heat and saute the Arborio rice for 2 minutes.
Add the white wine to the saucepan and cook until the liquid is almost completely absorbed.
Add 1 cup of chicken broth to the saucepan and stir until the liquid is mostly absorbed, then repeat this process until all the broth is used.
Stir in the palm sugar and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Remove the pork from the oven and let it rest for 10 minutes before slicing it thinly.
Stir in the grated parmesan cheese and chopped parsley, and season with salt and pepper to taste.
To serve, slice the roasted pork and serve it on top of the creamy risotto.
Deglaze the saucepan with a little bit of chicken broth to get all the caramelized bits from the bottom.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
Cook pork to an internal temperature of 63°C / 145°F and let it rest for 3 minutes before serving.
